remarks: Experience a new vision of sophisticated single-level living at the Vue New Canaan, an exciting premier luxury condominium community located in the heart of New Canaan. This sundrenched two-bedroom, two-bathroom unit also has a separate den/office. Uniquely styled living space features fine interior finishes & architectural details with a sun filled open floor plan, custom kitchen, master bedroom suite with spa-like bath, fireplace, private balcony & with city/park views. Unparalleled building amenities include a variety of concierge services, 2 state of the art fitness centers, natural playscape & Zen garden, underground dedicated 2 space parking with car detailing & pet washing station and personal storage unit. Entertain guests on the rooftop terrace w/outdoor kitchen, TV, firepit & stunning sunset views over Mead Park. Enjoy this luxurious lifestyle just steps from the village!
